source: The central lesson is that wall-clock speed is not determined by FLOP count alone. An algorithm can perform essentially the same mathematical work, and sometimes even recompute intermediate values, yet run faster because it moves far less data to and from high-bandwidth memory.
zh: 核心教训是挂钟速度不仅仅由 FLOP 计数决定。算法基本上可以执行相同的数学工作，有时甚至可以重新计算中间值，但运行速度更快，因为它在高带宽内存之间移入和移出的数据要少得多。
